thread:
zoe: okay team, new tradition proposal: Scone Sabbath. once a month we bring a scone and vow to judge it respectfully. whos in? :croissant:
harry: i'm in. but only if we have a ceremonial crumb-removal protocol. priorities.
meera: ceremony? i'm imagining tiny napkins and very sincere applause. :clap:
leila: can we alternate savory and sweet scones? my heart belongs to cheddar-chive.
badge-bot: Reminder: food in common areas should be labeled with name and date.
zoe: noted. labeling will be a solemn duty. will provide sticker labels that say "Scone of the Month".
harry: also proposing a sash for the scone judge. temporary felt sash, embroidered with "Keeper of Crumbs".
meera: i volunteer to sew tiny felt stars on the sash. low-key craft energy.
leila: are there rules for voting? does someone need to present tasting notes?
zoe: yes. tasting rubric: texture (crumb scale 1-5), butter ratio (1-5), dignity (1-5). final score is the sum of enlightened opinions.
harry: can we have a dodge clause for scones that are suspiciously dry? immediate disqualification.
meera: addendum: anyone who brings a scone that causes 3+ complaints must buy coffee for the team. fair enforcement.
leila: +1 for accountability. also, branding idea: mini crown toothpicks for winners.
badge-bot: Office policy reminder: food allergens should be listed. please annotate scones with common allergens.
zoe: will make an allergen sticker sheet. also drafting an official announcement for #announcements after the first ceremony.
harry: logistics: first Scone Sabbath this Friday at 3pm by the big window. say the word "crumb" to enter.
meera: love the password. i'll make a tiny parchment certificate for the inaugural winner. dramatic calligraphy included.
leila: i'll bring savory. harry, bring something sweet?
harry: it's a date. possibly blueberry. maybe regret. we'll see.
snack-bot: :cookie: snack-bot will tally votes if participants DM their scores with the format: crumb/text/dignity.
zoe: low-key important note: if anyone brings a scone-shaped object that is not edible (toy, paper), it will be considered a performance art entry and judged on intent.
meera: performance art entries encouraged. adds spice.
leila: can we add a "Most Unexpected Filling" side award? small sticker prize.
harry: also, photo ops mandatory. winner gets an office portrait next to the plant.
zoe: festival energy. final procedural note: this tradition is optional and meant to be inclusive. if you don't eat scones, you can be a judge or an official cheerer.
meera: cheerer accepted. i'll bring pom-poms (tiny).
leila: signing up on the shared doc: https://docs.example.com/placeholder (will update with sign-ups)
zoe: perfect. first Scone Sabbath: Friday 15:00. bring scone, label allergens, prepare dignity. long live the crumb. :sparkles:
